name: Dormimanía
description: Mexican mattress retailer based in Guadalajara with branches there and an online store on Shopify. Its shipping policy states delivery to 95 percent of the country subject to carrier coverage, with carrier-branch pickup (ocurre) where the carrier has no home coverage.
description_es: Tienda de colchones mexicana con sucursales en Guadalajara y tienda en línea en Shopify. Su política de envío indica entrega en el 95 por ciento del país según la cobertura de la paquetería, con servicio de ocurre donde no hay cobertura a domicilio.

ships_to.notes: Shipping policy says it delivers in 95 percent of the Republic, subject to carrier coverage; ocurre pickup at a carrier branch where there is none.

fulfillment.pickup_notes: Branches are listed in Guadalajara; collecting online orders there is not stated.

endpoints.notes: Plain-text llms.txt published by the store for AI assistants.

shopping_notes: Spanish-language Shopify store. Shipping policy asks buyers to check coverage before purchase and states a long delivery window.

sources.supports: 95 percent coverage, ocurre, own delivery in Guadalajara area
